parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

😎
aquarium[əkwɛəriəm]n.
An aquarium is a building where fish and underwater animals are kept.
→ We took a trip to the aquarium and saw a scary shark.
😎
arbitrary[a:rbitreri]adj.
If something is arbitrary, it is not based on any plan or system, so it seems random.
→ The classroom had many arbitrary rules that made me confused.
😎
autobiography[ɔ:təbaiɑgrəfi]n.
An autobiography is a true story of a person's life written by that person.
→ I read an autobiography about my favorite entertainer.
😎
convention[kənvenʃən]n.
A convention is behavior that is considered to be common or polite.
→ In the US, a popular convention is to shake hands when you meet someone.
😎
gracious[greiʃəs]adj.
If someone is gracious, then they are kind and helpful to those who need it.
→ The operator was gracious enough to help me find his number.
😎
improve[impru:v]v.
To improve something means to make it better.
→ He studied hard to improve his test scores from the previous year.
😎
insulate[insəleit]v.
To insulate something means to protect it from heat, cold, or noise.
→ People can conserve energy by insulating their houses.
😎
intrigue[intri:g]v.
To intrigue means to cause an interest in something or someone.
→ Her mysterious past intrigued her new friend.
😎
longevity[lɑndʒevəti]n.
Longevity is the ability to live for a long time.
→ Sea turtles have an amazing longevity.
😎
misplace[mispleis]v.
To misplace something means to lose it.
→ I misplaced my wallet, and I didn't find it until a week later.
😎
naughty[nɔ:ti]adj.
When children are naughty, they behave badly or do not do what they are told.
→ The boy had to go to his room because he was being naughty.
😎
norm[nɔ:rm]n.
A norm is a way of behaving that is considered normal in a particular society.
→ Wearing a heavy coat all summer is not considered a norm in the desert.
😎
orangutan[ɔ:ræŋutæn]n.
An orangutan is a large ape with red and brown hair and long arms.
→ Orangutans use their long arms to swing from trees.
😎
overload[ouvərloud]v.
To overload something means to put more things into it than it is meant to hold.
→ If you overload the truck, it might crash.
😎
philanthropy[filænθrəpi]n.
Philanthropy is the act of helping others, without wanting anything in return.
→ The wealthy business owner is well known for his acts of philanthropy.
😎
probe[proub]v.
To probe into something means to ask questions to discover facts about it.
→ The bank probed into his financial history to see if he qualified for a loan.
😎
recipient[risipiənt]n.
A recipient of something is the person who receives it.
→ I was the recipient of four phone calls today.
😎
reptile[reptail]n.
A reptile is a cold-blooded animal that lays eggs and has skin covered with scales.
→ Lizards are my favorite type of reptile.
😎
thrive[θraiv]v.
To thrive means to do well and be successful, healthy, or strong.
→ He may be an old man, but he continues to thrive.
😎
ultimate[ʌltəmit]adj.
When something is ultimate, it is the final result or aim of a long series of events.
→ By trying hard in school, I will reach my ultimate goal of becoming a doctor.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Choose the answer that best fits the question.

questions.content: 1. What would you find at an aquarium?
questions.explanation: Trong thủy cung (aquarium), bạn có thể tìm thấy một con mực (A squid).

questions.content: 2. What can you do to improve your grades?
questions.explanation: Bạn có thể học nhiều hơn (Study more) để cải thiện điểm số.

questions.content: 3. What is the ultimate result of going to college?
questions.explanation: Kết quả cuối cùng (ultimate result) của việc học đại học là lấy được bằng cấp (Getting a degree).

questions.content: 4. What happens if you insulate a house in the winter?
questions.explanation: Cách nhiệt (insulate) cho ngôi nhà vào mùa đông giúp giữ không khí lạnh ở bên ngoài.

questions.content: 5. Who would most likely publish an autobiography?
questions.explanation: Một người quan trọng (An important person) có khả năng cao xuất bản tự truyện (autobiography) của họ.

sections.title: Exercise 2: Choose the one that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

questions.content: 1. recipient
questions.explanation: recipient là người nhận, ngược lại là người cho (a giver).

questions.content: 2. misplace
questions.explanation: misplace là làm mất, ngược lại là tìm thấy (to find).

questions.content: 3. naughty
questions.explanation: naughty là hư hỏng, nghịch ngợm, ngược lại là cư xử tốt (behaving well).

questions.content: 4. longevity
questions.explanation: longevity là tuổi thọ cao, sống lâu, ngược lại là cuộc đời ngắn ngủi (short life).

questions.content: 5. thrive
questions.explanation: thrive là phát triển mạnh, làm tốt, ngược lại là làm tệ (to do bad).

questions.content: 6. gracious
questions.explanation: gracious là tử tế, tốt bụng, ngược lại là keo kiệt, xấu tính (mean).

questions.content: 7. norm
questions.explanation: norm là chuẩn mực, bình thường, ngược lại là bất thường (abnormal).

questions.content: 8. intrigue
questions.explanation: intrigue là gây hứng thú, tò mò, ngược lại là gây nhàm chán (to bore).

questions.content: 9. arbitrary
questions.explanation: arbitrary là ngẫu nhiên, tùy tiện, ngược lại là có kế hoạch (planned).

questions.content: 10. probe
questions.explanation: probe là thăm dò, hỏi han, ngược lại là phớt lờ (to ignore).

sections.title: Exercise 3: Write C if the italicized word is used correctly. Write I if the word is used incorrectly.

questions.content: 1. Make sure to misplace your money so that you will always have it.
questions.explanation: I (Incorrect). Misplace (làm mất) tiền sẽ khiến bạn không còn nó, chứ không phải luôn có nó.

questions.content: 2. The orangutans at the zoo swung so gracefully from the trees.
questions.explanation: C (Correct). Đười ươi (orangutans) đu đưa trên cây.

questions.content: 3. The tigers in the aquarium loved to run and play.
questions.explanation: I (Incorrect). Hổ (tigers) không sống trong thủy cung (aquarium).

questions.content: 4. The greedy man loved philanthropy. He never offered to help anybody.
questions.explanation: I (Incorrect). Người tham lam không bao giờ giúp đỡ ai thì không thể yêu thích lòng bác ái (philanthropy).

questions.content: 5. The box broke when he overloaded it with books.
questions.explanation: C (Correct). Chiếc hộp bị vỡ khi chất quá tải (overloaded) sách.

questions.content: 6. The mechanics of computers intrigue me.
questions.explanation: C (Correct). Cơ chế của máy tính gây hứng thú (intrigue) cho tôi.

questions.content: 7. The longevity of the rat was fifty centimeters.
questions.explanation: I (Incorrect). Longevity là tuổi thọ (thời gian sống), không đo bằng centimet (độ dài).

questions.content: 8. Plants will thrive if they are not given any water.
questions.explanation: I (Incorrect). Cây sẽ không thể phát triển mạnh mẽ (thrive) nếu không được tưới nước.

questions.content: 9. The naughty girl always obeyed her mother.
questions.explanation: I (Incorrect). Cô bé hư hỏng (naughty) thì không thể luôn vâng lời (obeyed) mẹ.

questions.content: 10. The ultimate result of the game was a win for the home team.
questions.explanation: C (Correct). Kết quả cuối cùng (ultimate result).

questions.content: 11. Some people play the lottery in hopes that they will improve their lives.
questions.explanation: C (Correct). Cải thiện (improve) cuộc sống.

questions.content: 12. Paying for gasoline before pumping it is a norm.
questions.explanation: C (Correct). Trả tiền xăng trước khi bơm là một điều bình thường/chuẩn mực (norm).

questions.content: 13. I probed the audience because I didn’t want to hear what they had to say.
questions.explanation: I (Incorrect). Probe là thăm dò, hỏi han. Nếu không muốn nghe thì sẽ không probe.

questions.content: 14. Waiting your turn in line is a social convention.
questions.explanation: C (Correct). Xếp hàng chờ đến lượt là một quy ước xã hội (social convention).

questions.content: 15. My dog is a great reptile.
questions.explanation: I (Incorrect). Chó là động vật có vú, không phải là loài bò sát (reptile).

questions.content: 16. I insulated my room with blankets to keep the loud noises out.
questions.explanation: C (Correct). Cách âm (insulated) bằng chăn để ngăn tiếng ồn.

questions.content: 17. She was the recipient of the grand prize.
questions.explanation: C (Correct). Người nhận (recipient) giải đặc biệt.

questions.content: 18. Someday, I will write my father’s autobiography.
questions.explanation: I (Incorrect). Autobiography là tự truyện (tự mình viết về mình). Nếu viết về bố thì gọi là biography (tiểu sử).

questions.content: 19. I don’t want to play with you anymore. You make up arbitrary rules as we play.
questions.explanation: C (Correct). Nghĩ ra những luật lệ tùy tiện (arbitrary rules).

questions.content: 20. The store clerk was so gracious. He helped me find everything I was looking for.
questions.explanation: C (Correct). Nhân viên cửa hàng rất tử tế (gracious).

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
The Lottery

Joe was watching television when he heard a knock at the door. He thought, "Who could that be? It's probably one of the naughty neighborhood children." Joe stood up and walked to the door. When he opened it, he saw a beautiful woman.

She said, "Good morning, Joe! I have great news. You're the recipient of this check for one million dollars! You won the lottery!"

Joe couldn't believe it. His mind was overloaded with emotions. Joe said, "Thank you! Thank you!"

After he calmed down, Joe made a photocopy of the check in case he misplaced the original one. He sat and thought about what he wanted to do with the money. He didn't want to spend it in an arbitrary way. Joe thought, "I know there are others who need this money more than I do. I've always loved animals, so I think I'll buy things for the zoo!"

Joe knew that the zoo was in bad shape. The cages were too small, and they weren't insulated from the cold. Animals couldn't thrive in such conditions.

He took out some stationery and wrote a letter to the zoo. He offered to help the zoo buy huge cages for the large mammals and reptiles. He offered to buy healthy food for the orangutans to increase their longevity. He even said that he would buy new glass walls for the aquarium because the old ones were cracked.

Joe's act of philanthropy intrigued the zookeeper. He probed Joe to learn why he spent his money to improve the zoo. It wasn't a social convention for a person to be so gracious.

Joe told the zookeeper, "I know it's not the norm, but my ultimate decision to help these animals is better than anything I could have done for myself. If I ever write an autobiography, I will write that this was the happiest day of my life."

sections.title: Part A: Mark each statement T for true or F for false. Rewrite the false statements to make them true.

questions.content: 1. Joe was the recipient of a check because he won the lottery.
questions.explanation: Đúng. Joe là người nhận tấm séc vì anh đã trúng xổ số.

questions.content: 2. He wanted to buy new glass walls for the aquarium because the old ones were cracked.
questions.explanation: Đúng. Anh ấy muốn mua kính mới cho thuỷ cung vì những cái cũ đã bị nứt.

questions.content: 3. If Joe wrote an autobiography, he would write about the norms of the overloaded aquarium.
questions.explanation: Sai. Nếu viết tự truyện (autobiography), anh ấy sẽ viết rằng ngày trúng số và giúp đỡ động vật là ngày hạnh phúc nhất đời anh.

questions.content: 4. Joe made a photocopy of the check in case he misplaced the original one.
questions.explanation: Đúng. Anh ấy photo tấm séc phòng trường hợp làm mất (misplaced) bản gốc.

questions.content: 5. When Joe opened the door, he saw one of the naughty neighborhood children.
questions.explanation: Sai. Khi mở cửa, anh ấy nhìn thấy một người phụ nữ xinh đẹp mang theo tấm séc.

questions.content: 1. What did Joe think the naughty children were doing to him?
options: Joe thought the naughty neighborhood children were playing a trick on him.
Joe thought they were selling cookies.
Joe thought they wanted his money.
questions.explanation: Joe nghĩ những đứa trẻ nghịch ngợm hàng xóm đang trêu đùa anh.

questions.content: 2. Why did Joe take out stationery?
options: He took out some stationery to write a letter to the zoo.
He took out some stationery to write a book.
He took out some stationery to draw a picture.
He took out some stationery to write a check.
questions.explanation: Anh lấy giấy bút ra để viết một lá thư gửi cho sở thú.

questions.content: 3. What did Joe improve to help the orangutans increase their longevity?
options: He bought healthy food for them.
He bought new toys for them.
He bought bigger trees for them.
He bought new cages for them.
questions.explanation: Anh ấy đã mua thức ăn tốt cho đười ươi để giúp chúng sống lâu hơn.

questions.content: 4. What was the purpose of the zookeeper wanting to probe Joe with questions?
options: He probed Joe to learn why he spent his money on the zoo instead of on himself.
He probed Joe to see if he was rich.
He probed Joe to ask for more money.
He probed Joe to sell him a ticket.
questions.explanation: Nhân viên sở thú gạn hỏi để tìm hiểu lý do tại sao Joe dùng tiền cho sở thú thay vì cho bản thân.

questions.content: 5. If Joe were to write an autobiography, how would he describe this day?
options: He would describe this day as the happiest day of his life.
He would describe this day as a normal day.
He would describe this day as the luckiest day.
He would describe this day as the most confusing day.
questions.explanation: Anh ấy sẽ miêu tả ngày hôm nay là ngày hạnh phúc nhất trong cuộc đời anh.
